title: 第21章 困阵 下第22章 野心
slug: 修仙我觉醒了美食系统
content_zh:
“魏淑琴，你看我。”
“我其实也是一个普通人。”
“我是……我该怎么说才好。”
“嗯……”
“我是另一个世界的你，一个没有父母但依旧活得很好的你。”
“我有自己的小屋，虽然是租的。”
“我有一条没心没肺的小狗，虽然是捡的。”
“我呢，还有一个总是喜欢邀功、抢功的垃圾领导。”
“我在我的那个世界没有灵根，只是一个普通的打工仔。”
“我还喜欢周末去逛街打卡。”
“等我回去。”
“我把灵根这些全都还给你，好不好？”
魏淑琴将拳头打在林江月的身上，血渍染红了内衬。
“哼！你会甘心？少来诓骗我！”
林江月眼神闪动挪着身子坐在石凳上，长叹一声。
她语气低沉却有力地说道：“我初来时腿骨被石长捷折断，晕厥过去，原以为能回到自己的世界，没想到醒来时，只有剧烈的疼痛和一眼望不到头的山顶。”
“后来有了落脚处，又被人拿着剑抵住喉咙，差点死了。”
“还有一次我被夜影兽困在绝处，那夜影兽只需一口就能咬碎我的骨头，那次也差点死掉。”
“这一切，在原来世界的我绝不会经历，我只会安安稳稳、平平淡淡的过完这一生。”
“这一切换做是你，你会不会害怕，会不会心惊？”

魏淑琴咬住嘴唇，捏的拳头红的发紫。
“我不会！”
林江月冷哼了一声。
“不会害怕是假的，哪有人不珍惜自己的命。”
说到此处林江月仰天落泪。
“可害怕又有什么用呢？”
“还不是要面对！”
“你应该庆幸没有经历这一切，这一切真的太不容易了！”
“哪怕是我，哪怕我有些机缘，活着对我来说也只是侥幸！”
“不甘心会不会有？”
“肯定会！”
“我经历的这一切，又得到的这一切，都太不容易了！”
content_en:
"Wei Shuqin, look at me."
"I am actually an ordinary person."
"I am...how should I say it."
"Well..."
"I am you in another world, a you who has no parents but is still living well."
"I have my own cabin, although I rent it."
"I have a heartless puppy, even though I picked it up."
"I also have a rubbish leader who always likes to take credit and grab credit."
"I have no spiritual roots in my world, I am just an ordinary wage earner."
“I also like to go shopping on weekends to check in.”
"Wait until I get back."
"I'll return all the spiritual roots to you, okay?"
Wei Shuqin punched Lin Jiangyue's body, and the blood stained the lining red.
"Hmph! Are you willing to do so? Stop trying to trick me!"
Lin Jiangyue's eyes flashed as she moved to sit on the stone bench and sighed.
She said in a low but powerful tone: "When I first came here, my leg bone was broken by Shi Changjie and I fainted. I thought I could return to my own world. Unexpectedly, when I woke up, there was only severe pain and an endless mountain top."
"Later I found a place to stay, and someone held a sword to my throat. I almost died."
"Another time I was trapped in a desperate situation by the Night Shadow Beast. The Night Shadow Beast could crush my bones with just one bite. I almost died that time."
"I would never have experienced any of this in my original world. I would only live my life peacefully and peacefully."
"If this switch is yours, will you be scared or frightened?"
Wei Shuqin bit her lip and her fists turned red and purple.
"I won't!"
Lin Jiangyue snorted coldly.
"If you don't fear it's a lie, how can anyone not cherish their own life?"
Speaking of this, Lin Jiangyue looked up to the sky and shed tears.
"But what's the use of being afraid?"
"It's not like we have to face it yet!"
"You should be glad you didn't go through this, it's really not easy!"
"Even if it's me, even if I have some opportunities, being alive is just a fluke for me!"
"Is there any unwillingness?"
"Definitely!"
"Everything I have experienced and everything I have received is so difficult!"
